director.name: Ridley Scott
director.bio: British filmmaker known for his highly visual and atmospheric directing style

title: Alien
description: A space crew encounters a deadly alien creature on a derelict spacecraft.

director.name: George Lucas
director.bio: American filmmaker and creator of the Star Wars and Indiana Jones franchises

title: Star Wars: Episode IV - A New Hope
description: Luke Skywalker joins forces with a Jedi Knight, a pilot, and a pair of droids to save the galaxy from the Empire.

director.name: Terry Gilliam
director.bio: American-born British director known for his imaginative and surreal style

title: 12 Monkeys
description: In a future world devastated by disease, a convict is sent back in time to gather information about the man-made virus that wiped out humanity.

director.name: Stanley Kubrick
director.bio: Influential American filmmaker known for his meticulous craftsmanship

title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
description: Humanity's evolution is observed by an alien monolith, leading to a mission to Jupiter where the true nature of the monolith is explored.

director.name: Paul Verhoeven
director.bio: Dutch director known for his work on action and science fiction films

title: RoboCop
description: In a dystopian Detroit, a terminally wounded cop returns to the force as a powerful cyborg with suppressed memories.

director.name: Neill Blomkamp
director.bio: South African filmmaker known for his exploration of sociopolitical themes in science fiction

title: District 9
description: An alien race forced to live in slum-like conditions in Johannesburg finds a kindred spirit in a government agent exposed to their biotechnology.

director.name: Luc Besson
director.bio: French filmmaker known for his visually striking and action-packed films

title: The Fifth Element
description: In a colorful futuristic world, a cab driver becomes involved in a quest to save humanity by reuniting five mystical elements.

director.name: Alex Garland
director.bio: British filmmaker and novelist known for his work in science fiction and psychological thrillers

title: Ex Machina
description: A young programmer is selected to participate in a groundbreaking experiment in synthetic intelligence by evaluating the human qualities of a highly advanced humanoid A.I.

director.name: Danny Boyle
director.bio: British director known for his visually inventive filmmaking style

title: Sunshine
description: A team of international astronauts is sent on a dangerous mission to reignite the dying Sun with a nuclear fission bomb.

director.name: Andrew Niccol
director.bio: New Zealand filmmaker known for his exploration of dystopian themes

title: Gattaca
description: In a future society genetically engineered to produce flawless humans, a man challenges his fate to pursue his lifelong dream of space travel.
